result.instructions: Tools for People Data Labs, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes People Data Labs data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run peopledatalabs_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run peopledatalabs_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run peopledatalabs_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. peopledatalabs_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pdl_person_enrich
tools.title: Enrich a person
tools.description: Find the single best-matching person profile for a set of identifying attributes (name, email, phone, profile URL, company, etc.). Returns one record plus a likelihood score (1-10), or a 404 'no match' body. Use uniquely-identifying inputs for best results. API: GET /person/enrich.

email.description: Email address, or an array of email addresses.

profile.description: Social profile URL(s), e.g. a LinkedIn URL. String or array.

pdl_id.description: PDL persistent ID for a person record.

company.description: Company name, website, or PDL company id the person works at.

school.description: School name or website the person attended.

location.description: Free-text location, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA, USA'.

postal_code.description: Postal / ZIP code (assumed US if no country).

min_likelihood.description: Only return a 200 if match confidence >= this (1-10).

required.description: Only return a match that contains these fields, e.g. 'emails AND mobile_phone'.

titlecase.description: Titlecase the returned data (default false = lowercase).

tools.name: pdl_person_identify
tools.title: Identify a person
tools.description: Given broad, possibly-ambiguous attributes about a person, return up to 20 strongly-related profiles ranked by match score. Sits between enrich (1:1) and search (open-ended) — ideal when you can't uniquely resolve someone. API: GET /person/identify.

email.description: Email address, or an array of email addresses.

profile.description: Social profile URL(s), e.g. a LinkedIn URL. String or array.

pdl_id.description: PDL persistent ID for a person record.

company.description: Company name, website, or PDL company id the person works at.

school.description: School name or website the person attended.

location.description: Free-text location, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA, USA'.

postal_code.description: Postal / ZIP code (assumed US if no country).

titlecase.description: Titlecase the returned data (default false = lowercase).

tools.name: pdl_person_search
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Search the full PDL Person Dataset with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string over the Person Schema (e.g. everyone with job_title_role='engineering' at a company). Returns matching profiles sorted by completeness; paginate with scroll_token. Each returned record costs 1 credit. API: POST /person/search.

query.description: Elasticsearch query as a JSON string, e.g. {"query":{"term":{"job_company_name":"people data labs"}}} — pass the value of "query".

sql.description: SQL query string, e.g. SELECT * FROM person WHERE job_company_name='people data labs'.

size.description: Number of records to return (1-100). Default 1.

scroll_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

dataset.description: Dataset(s) to search: resume, email, phone, mobile_phone, street_address, consumer_social, developer, all. Comma-separate; prefix '-' to exclude.

tools.name: pdl_company_enrich
tools.title: Enrich a company
tools.description: Find the single best-matching company record. Requires a non-ambiguous input — name OR website OR ticker OR profile (website/ticker/profile resolve more reliably than name). Returns firmographics (industry, size, location, etc.) or a 404 'no match' body. API: GET /company/enrich.

ticker.description: Stock ticker for a public company, e.g. 'AAPL'.

profile.description: Company social profile URL, e.g. a LinkedIn company URL.

pdl_id.description: PDL id for a company record.

tools.name: pdl_company_search
tools.title: Search companies
tools.description: Search the full PDL Company Dataset with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string over the Company Schema (e.g. all SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in the US). Paginate with scroll_token. Each returned record costs 1 credit. API: POST /company/search.

query.description: Elasticsearch query as a JSON string, e.g. {"query":{"term":{"industry":"computer software"}}} — pass the value of "query".

sql.description: SQL query string, e.g. SELECT * FROM company WHERE industry='computer software'.

size.description: Number of records to return (1-100). Default 1.

scroll_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: pdl_ip_enrich
tools.title: Enrich an IP address
tools.description: Enrich an IP address with its location, company, and (optionally) associated person data via a 1:1 match against PDL's IP dataset. API: GET /ip/enrich.

ip.description: The IP address to enrich, e.g. '72.212.42.169'.

return_person.description: Include associated person data if available.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence level required to return a match.

tools.name: pdl_autocomplete
tools.title: Autocomplete search values
tools.description: Get suggested values for a search field along with the number of available records for each — useful for building valid Person/Company Search queries. Free on all plans. API: GET /autocomplete.

field.description: Field to autocomplete: e.g. company, school, location, region, country, industry, title, role, sub_role, skill, major.

text.description: Partial text to get suggestions for, e.g. 'stanf'.

tools.name: pdl_job_posting_search
tools.title: Search job postings
tools.description: Search PDL's Job Posting Dataset (millions of active & historical postings sourced from company career pages) with an Elasticsearch query object OR a SQL string. Beta — may require plan access (HTTP 403 if not enabled). Each returned posting costs 1 credit. API: POST /job_posting/search.

query.description: Elasticsearch query as a JSON string, e.g. {"query":{"term":{"title_role":"engineering"}}} — pass the value of "query".

sql.description: SQL query string over the job posting dataset.

size.description: Number of records to return (1-100). Default 1.

scroll_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.
